description: This Java class DefaultRateConfig provides configuration for throttling connection recovery, including frequency duration and entity amount, implementing the ReconnectConfig.RateConfig interface.

classes.name: DefaultRateConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing RateConfig with fields for frequency and entity amount, providing configuration for connection throttling.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method creating an instance of DefaultRateConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: getFrequency
methods.description: Returns the duration of the frequency for throttling.

methods.name: getEntityAmount
methods.description: Returns the number of entities associated with the rate configuration.
